newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Gigante cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gigante cut to neutral.

text.p: The Banacci brokerage said on Monday it had downgraded Mexican supermarket chain Grupo Gigante SA de CV to neutral from buy.
-- Analyst Alfredo Dmaz said the downgrade was mostly due to a 43 percent increase in the share price over the past two months.
-- "We consider that the improvement in operating results of the first half of the year already has been taken into account in the share price," Dmaz wrote in a report.
-- The supermarket sector has shown a steady increase in sales and profits in 1997, but Gigante has lagged the sector, in part because of a major remodeling project, Dmaz said.
